chunks.text: Today we are going to talk about Indonesia.
Indonesia is a very interesting country.
It has beautiful places, delicious food, and kind people.
Where is Indonesia?
Indonesia is in Southeast Asia.
It is between two oceans, the Indian Ocean and the Pacific Ocean.
Indonesia is also close to other countries like Malaysia, Singapore, the Philippines, Australia, and Papua New Guinea.
Indonesia is a very big country, but it is not just one piece of land.
It is made of many islands.
How many islands?
More than 17,000.
That is a lot.
Some islands are big and some are very small.
People live on about 6,000 of these islands.
The biggest islands are Sumatra, Java, Borneo, Sulawesi, and Papua.
The capital city of Indonesia is Jakarta.
Jakarta is on the island of Java.
It is a big busy city with many people, cars, and buildings.
More than 10 million people live in Jakarta.
Nature in Indonesia Indonesia has amazing nature.
There are mountains, forests, rivers, and beautiful beaches.
Many people visit Indonesia to see nature.
One of the most famous places in Indonesia is Bali.
Bali is an island with beautiful beaches and green rice fields.
Many tourists visit Bali every year.
People love the warm weather, the friendly people, and the culture.
Indonesia also has volcanoes.
A volcano is a mountain that can explode with fire and smoke.
Indonesia has more than 100 active volcanoes.
One famous volcano is Mount Bromo.
Another famous volcano is Mount Marapi.
Some people climb these volcanoes to see the amazing view.
Indonesia also has rainforests.
These forests have many trees and animals.
One famous animal in Indonesia is the orangutan.
Orangutans are big, orange monkeys.
They live in the forests of Sumatra and Borneo.
Sadly, orangutans are in danger because people cut down trees.
Food in Indonesia Indonesian food is delicious.
There are many different dishes, but here are some famous ones.
Nasi goreng.
This is fried rice with vegetables.
Egg and sometimes chicken or shrimp.
It is very popular in Indonesia.
Sete.
Sete is grilled meat on a stick.
People eat it with peanut sauce.
Rendang.
This is a slow -cooked beef dish.
It has many spices and is very tasty.
Gadogado.
This is an Indonesian salad with vegetables tofu and peanut sauce.
Soto.
This is a type of soup.
It has meat, noodles, and vegetables.
Many Indonesian dishes are spicy because they use a lot of chili peppers.
People and Language Indonesia has a population of more than 270 million people.
That is a lot.
It is the fourth most populated country in the world, after China, India, and the United States.
The official language of Indonesia is Bahasa Indonesia.
But Indonesia has many different cultures and languages.
There are more than 700 local languages in Indonesia.
Some people speak Javanese, Sundanese, Balinese, and many others.
Many people in Indonesia also speak English, especially in big cities and tourist places.
Culture and Traditions Indonesia has a rich culture.
There are many different traditional dances, music, and clothes.
One famous Indonesian dance is the Balinese lagong dance.
It is a beautiful dance from Bali.
The dancers wear colorful clothes and move their hands and eyes in a special way.
Indonesian music is also unique.
A famous musical instrument from Indonesia is the gamelan.
Gamelan is a group of instruments like drums, gongs, and metal xylophones.
People play gamelan music at festivals and ceremonies.
Indonesia is also famous for batik.
Batik is a traditional way of making clothes.
People use wax and dye to create beautiful patterns on fabric.
Every region in Indonesia has its own batik style.
Religion in Indonesia Indonesia has many religions.
The main religion is Islam.
Most people in Indonesia are Muslim, but there are also Christians, Hindus, Buddhists, and other religions.
On the island of Bali, most people are Hindu.
In other parts of Indonesia, there are Christian and Buddhist communities.
People in Indonesia are very tolerant and respectful of different religions.
They celebrate many religious holidays, like Eid, Christmas, and Hindu festivals.
That is all for today.
Now you know many things about Indonesia.
It is a big beautiful country with amazing people, food, and culture.
Thank you for listening to Slow English Podcast.
I hope you learned something new today.
If you liked this episode, please share it with your friends.
See you next time.
Bye -bye.
